attchmntText: Ballarpur Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Ballarpur Industries Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 15, 2026, regarding its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The ads appeared in the Financial Express and Lakshdeep newspapers. Multiplus Holdings Limited reported a net profit of 37.74 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Mystic Electronics Limited reported a net profit of 10.20 lakhs for the same period. Omkar Chemicals Limited published advertisements for its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Sonal Constructions Limited published advertisements for its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

attchmntText: Ballarpur Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Ballarpur Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Ballarpur Industries Limited has authorized specific Key Managerial Personnel to determine the materiality of events and make disclosures to stock exchanges under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The designated individuals are Mr. Hardik Patel, Whole Time Director; Mr. Alok Prakash, Whole Time Director and Chief Executive Officer; Mr. Anil Mehta, Chief Financial Officer; and Ms. Priya Pandey, Company Secretary. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The details have been posted on the company website at www.biltpaper.in.

attchmntText: Ballarpur Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Priya Pandey as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ballarpur Industries Limited has appointed Ms. Priya Pandey as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from November 14, 2026. Ms. Pandey holds ACS number 66213 and is an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. She is a Commerce and Law graduate with over 7 years of experience in Secretarial, Legal, Regulatory affairs, and Compliance functions. She holds no equity shares in the company and is not related to any director on the Board. The appointment is made pursuant to Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013, and Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was signed by Hardik Patel, Whole-Time Director, with DIN 00590666.

attchmntText: Ballarpur Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Ms Surbhi Dinesh Chachada as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. closure of business hours of November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ballarpur Industries Limited intimates that Ms. Surbhi Dinesh Chachada, Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer, has tendered her resignation due to personal occupancy, effective from the closing of business hours on November 13, 2026. The Board of Directors accepted her resignation during the meeting held on November 13, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The resignation letter is enclosed with the intimation.

attchmntText: Ballarpur Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ballarpur Industries Limited reported a net loss of 2,316.67 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company recorded revenue from operations of 8,610.71 lakh rupees. The Board approved the unaudited financial statements. Ms. Surbhi Dinesh Chachada resigned as Company Secretary effective November 13, 2026. Ms. Priya Pandey was appointed as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 14, 2026. The Board noted nil deviation in the utilization of NCD issue proceeds. Contact details for Key Managerial Personnel were updated. Total assets stood at 1,30,933.78 lakh rupees as of September 30, 2026.
